messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: DETECTED - Spike in notification delivery errors 12:04 UTC. Metrics: Twilio 5xx rate +17% (EU region), SendGrid 4xx/5xx bounce spike +12%. Affected routes: /notifications/verify, /notifications/digest. Auto-alert -> #incidents and pagerduty P1.
Maya Chen: ack, taking lead. Paging SRE oncall and Eng-runtime.
pagerduty: Paging @Ravi Patel (sre-oncall) and @Jasper Lee (runtime). Escalation level: P1.
Ravi Patel: on it — checking request traces and queue depths. Increasing trace sampling to 5% for affected routes.
Jasper Lee: seeing repeated 504s from Twilio in eu-west-1 cluster, connection resets to SendGrid SMTP gateway (421). Throughput held ~40 TPS to Twilio.
Noelle Rivera: Customer-impact summary: signup OTPs and password-reset emails failing intermittently. CS reports ~120 failed verification attempts in last 10m across NA/EU.
Maya Chen: plan — enable provider fallbacks (sms -> Telnyx, email -> Mailgun) and enable retry-in-queue for verification flow. Will update routing via internal API.
Maya Chen: Execute fallback (internal CLI):
```
curl -X POST "https://console.internal.redwood/v1/route/fallback"
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_API"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{
    "service": "notifications",
    "sms_provider": "telnyx",
    "email_provider": "mailgun",
    "ttl_sec": 3600
  }'
```
Ravi Patel: running quick PromQL to confirm error sources:
```
sum(rate(twilio_outbound_5xx_total[5m])) by (region)
sum(rate(sendgrid_smtp_tempfail[5m]))
```
Jasper Lee: flip done for sms fallback in eu-west-1, email fallback staged in config -> applying now. Also enabled feature flag notify.retries=3 for verification flow.
incident-bot: Created incident channel #incident-1768567890 and pinned runbook (notifications/fallbacks).
Support Agent (CS): CS notified, drafting customer messages and support tickets. Will add a banner on status.redwood.ai: "We are investigating delivery delays for SMS and email notifications; fallbacks enabled."
Maya Chen: handoff in ~10m to Noelle Rivera (night oncall). I'll stay for 10 to watch metrics then hand over.
Noelle Rivera: taking handoff. Confirmed fallback routing applied. Observed Twilio 5xx drop from ~18% -> ~6% in 5m after Telnyx take-over. Mailgun showing successful deliveries for previously bounced messages.
Ravi Patel: traces show retries succeeded for ~86% of previously failed requests after fallback. Queue lengths normalized.
Jasper Lee: added short-term circuit breaker on Twilio route: if 5xx_rate > 10% for 3m then auto-failover. Need follow-up to make this permanent.
Support Agent (CS): Posted update to customers and triaged highest priority merchant tickets. Cookie-cutter message used for affected users.
Maya Chen: creating immediate action items: 1) permanent provider failover automation, 2) add circuit breaker + alert, 3) runbook update, 4) postmortem owners eng-sre + eng-runtime.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: INCIDENT UPDATE - Providers stabilized. SendGrid SMTP errors subsided at ~12:48 UTC; Twilio recovered in EU by ~12:52 UTC. Fallbacks remain active for now.
Noelle Rivera: will monitor for 2 hours then revert to primary providers if no regressions. Setting a reminder for revert at 14:55 UTC.
Jasper Lee: logged three follow-ups in backlog: provider failover infra, better per-region telemetry, and test chaos scenarios for vendor outages.
Maya Chen: good work everyone. Closing live page after monitoring window. Please add detailed RCA notes to the incident doc and schedule a 1h postmortem review tomorrow 09:00 PST.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (1768567890) — Final status: delivery success rates recovered to baseline, fallbacks to remain for 1h, no data loss. Close incident in 2h after RCA. :tada:
